from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper in the collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the text")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
